description.subject: A small toy figure with a smooth white head, drawn-on dot eyes, red round cheeks and a smile, topped with a cap of black and grey striped hair.

description.setting: A beach of dark grey, flat pebbles in front of a layered tan and brown sandstone cliff, with three small out-of-focus walkers in the distance.
description.light: Soft, diffuse daylight from an overcast sky, with no hard shadows and a muted, slightly warm cast on the cliff.
description.materials: Red wool knit, yellow molded plastic, a translucent red dome held against the sweater front, and wet-looking grey pebbles with banded sandstone behind.
